title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. Version 1.2.51 adds 245 revision-pinned Gemma-2-9B-IT BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. Release candidate only; no new DOI is claimed. Summary: 68,402 valid samples, 598 probe cells, 199 model labels; Colab labels are counted separately from historical deployments and are not unique-weight identities.
